facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: improvement notice - critical safeguard at PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on PSV-4210 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during shift handover while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 31 May 2011 a regulatory notice was issued concerning PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following shift handover.
